hypotheses.claim: Roadworks on Harbor St are reducing foot and car traffic at lunch.
supporting: Lane closure confirmed in local news
Drop began the same week roadworks started
counter: Other stores without roadworks also saw a small dip on rain days

hypotheses.claim: A competitor's $5 lunch deal is pulling price-sensitive customers away.
supporting: Deal launched two days after roadworks
Two rain days with lower sales
counter: Only 2 of 15 weekdays; drop is persistent

hypotheses.claim: Long lunchtime lines are causing customers to give up.

unknown: Public data can't tell us why lost regulars actually left, or which single change would bring them back. Price, speed, and convenience all look plausible from the outside.

question.text: What would bring you back to Store 14 for lunch?

rationale: Three hypotheses (price, access, speed) map to three concrete levers. One question forces a clear trade-off from people who actually stopped visiting.
